bute_oldman.text: Alright, mush. That is what we say in Cardiff. Mush means mate.
This is Butetown, known as Tiger Bay. Sailors from all over the world lived here, and it is one of the oldest mixed communities in Britain.
Shirley Bassey grew up round the corner. When she sang, the whole bay listened. So did the Chipgulls, but only for chips.
